Used H100 unit resale ~$8-28k (2026) vs $25-40k new -- a 35-65% residual, wide variance by vintage/condition.

release_timeline_note: sourced release/availability dates per whatledto.com Nvidia datacenter GPU roadmap and vendor announcements; pricing series are a mix of sourced snapshots (aimultiple.com, GPUSmith, SemiAnalysis, IntuitionLabs -- all cited inline) interpolated across quarters where no snapshot exists (marked estimate:true throughout).
design_note: H100 pricing is NOT monotonically declining -- it fell 2024-mid2025 then ROSE again Oct2025-Mar2026 (SemiAnalysis, sourced) as neocloud long-term contract demand outpaced the Blackwell ramp. This non-monotonic curve is a deliberate, sourced feature -- don't smooth it away in implementation.
